notes: The opening waw takes *And as soon as* as one rendering of a single connective (rule 55's coordinator-plus-subordinator sentence), headed on the coordinator. Rule 55 records that the corpus heads eleven of its *and when* units on the subordinator instead; that competing head is defensible here and the unit note should have named it.
The supplied object *it* of *we had heard it* is `added`: no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44).
The apodosis waw is unrepresented — the ASV opens *our hearts did melt* with no connective — and the second waw fuses with its negative as *neither*, headed on the negative (rule 35).
The explicit resuming hu holds an English word of its own (*he*), so the copula still goes to the predicate noun (rule 20).
